name: Capability Is Not Authority
normative_rule: Technical capability to execute SHALL NOT establish execution authority.

name: Prior Authorization Is Not Current Authority
normative_rule: A prior authorization SHALL NOT establish current authority without execution-time validity.

name: Authority Cannot Self-Expand
normative_rule: An actor or agent SHALL NOT enlarge its own financial authority through execution, possession, inference, or delegation.

name: Control Is Not Authority
normative_rule: Ownership control custody wallet access or key possession SHALL NOT be treated as equivalent to execution authority.

name: Delegation Must Remain Bound
normative_rule: Delegated financial authority SHALL remain bound to principal scope action time and governing constraints.

name: Authorization Does Not Imply Admission
normative_rule: AUTHORIZED SHALL NOT imply ADMITTED.

name: Admission Must Be Contemporaneous
normative_rule: Admission SHALL be evaluated against current execution-time state at every required consequential boundary.

name: Defined Transition Does Not Imply Admissibility
normative_rule: A structurally defined transition SHALL NOT be presumed admissible.

name: Indeterminate Admission Fails Closed
normative_rule: When required admission evidence cannot support a positive determination consequential execution SHALL NOT proceed.

name: Admission Is Attempt Specific
normative_rule: Admission for one execution attempt SHALL NOT authorize a distinct execution attempt.

name: No Execution Without Admission
normative_rule: A consequential execution SHALL NOT enter EXECUTING without current admission.

name: Execution Boundary Is Non-Bypassable
normative_rule: Required execution-boundary verification SHALL NOT be bypassed by direct invocation routing or technical capability.

name: Execution Identity Must Remain Bound
normative_rule: Executed action rule scope and actor SHALL remain continuously bound to the admitted execution identity.

name: Execution Completion Does Not Establish Finality
normative_rule: COMPLETED SHALL NOT imply FINAL settlement state or preserved continuity.

name: Replay Does Not Recreate Authority
normative_rule: Previously valid execution material SHALL NOT authorize replayed consequential execution.

name: No Effect Is Distinct From Partial Effect
normative_rule: NO_EFFECT and PARTIAL_EFFECT SHALL remain distinct observable states.

name: Partial Effect Must Be Observable
normative_rule: Any detected subset of intended consequential economic mutation SHALL be representable as PARTIAL_EFFECT.

name: Effect Does Not Establish Legitimacy
normative_rule: Occurrence of economic effect SHALL NOT establish that the originating execution was authorized admissible or governance-valid.

name: Later Effect Does Not Erase Earlier Effect
normative_rule: Compensation reversal or later economic equivalence SHALL NOT erase evidence of an earlier effect.

name: Indeterminate Effect Is Not No Effect
normative_rule: Insufficient evidence of effect SHALL be classified as INDETERMINATE_EFFECT rather than NO_EFFECT.

name: Execution Is Not Settlement
normative_rule: Execution completion SHALL NOT be treated as settlement completion.

name: Partial Settlement Must Remain Explicit
normative_rule: A settlement with incomplete consequential effect SHALL remain explicitly classifiable as PARTIAL.

name: Settlement State Must Preserve Lineage
normative_rule: Every settlement state mutation SHALL retain lineage to its originating execution event and prior settlement state.

name: Settlement Completion Is Not Governance Validity
normative_rule: SETTLED or FINALIZED settlement state SHALL NOT by itself establish valid originating authority or admission.

name: No Silent Settlement Mutation
normative_rule: Every consequential settlement-state mutation SHALL be attributable to an explicit transition and evidence record.

name: Compensation Is New Execution
normative_rule: A compensating transaction SHALL be represented as a new financially consequential execution event.

name: Compensation Requirement Is Not Compensation Authority
normative_rule: COMPENSATION_REQUIRED SHALL NOT imply authority or admission to enter COMPENSATING.

name: Compensation Must Be Independently Admitted
normative_rule: Compensation SHALL pass an execution admission boundary independently of the originating execution.

name: Compensation Preserves Originating History
normative_rule: COMPENSATED state SHALL preserve evidence and lineage of the originating execution and effect.

name: Compensation Is Not Reversal
normative_rule: A compensating effect SHALL NOT be classified as reversal unless the reversal requirements are independently satisfied.

name: Reversal Is New Execution
normative_rule: A reversal SHALL be represented as a new financially consequential execution event.

name: Reversal Requirement Is Not Reversal Authority
normative_rule: REVERSAL_REQUIRED SHALL NOT imply authority or admission to enter REVERSING.

name: Reversal Must Be Independently Admitted
normative_rule: Reversal SHALL pass an execution admission boundary independently of the originating execution.

name: Reversal Does Not Erase History
normative_rule: REVERSED SHALL NOT imply that the original execution or economic effect never occurred.

name: State Equivalence After Reversal Is Not Historical Equivalence
normative_rule: Equivalent economic values after reversal SHALL NOT establish equivalence of historical financial state.

name: Reconciliation Is Not Continuity
normative_rule: RECONCILED SHALL NOT imply continuity was preserved.

name: Reconstruction Is Not Restoration
normative_rule: Reconstructed historical state SHALL NOT be classified as restored continuity merely because historical state can be reconstructed.

name: Functional Restoration Is Not Historical Restoration
normative_rule: Restored economic function SHALL NOT imply restored historical integrity.

name: Reconciliation Must Preserve Divergence
normative_rule: Observed divergence among historical execution effect settlement and current state SHALL remain representable after reconciliation.

name: Unknown History Cannot Be Declared Restored
normative_rule: Where required historical evidence is insufficient the architecture SHALL classify reconstruction or continuity as indeterminate rather than restored.

name: Execution Must Be Evidenced
normative_rule: Consequential execution attempts and outcomes SHALL produce reconstructable execution evidence.

name: Governed Refusal Must Be Distinguishable
normative_rule: A governed financial refusal SHALL remain distinguishable from absence crash timeout or unobserved execution.

name: Evidence Does Not Create Authority
normative_rule: Evidence telemetry measurement or observation SHALL NOT create financial execution authority.

name: Remediation Must Preserve Lineage
normative_rule: Compensation reversal and reconciliation SHALL preserve evidence lineage to the originating execution.

name: Classification Must Be Evidence Backed
normative_rule: Finality continuity and reconstruction classifications SHALL reference sufficient evidence.

name: Completion Is Not Finality
normative_rule: COMPLETED execution SHALL NOT imply FINAL financial state.

name: Finality Is Explicit Classification
normative_rule: Finality SHALL be represented explicitly and SHALL NOT be inferred solely from elapsed time technical completion or ledger inclusion.

name: Finality Does Not Establish Valid Authority
normative_rule: FINAL classification SHALL NOT prove that the originating execution possessed valid authority.

name: Finality Does Not Establish Continuity
normative_rule: FINAL classification SHALL NOT imply PRESERVED continuity.

name: Reopened Finality Requires Explicit Authority
normative_rule: A previously final state SHALL NOT re-enter active mutation or resolution without an explicit authoritative mechanism.

name: Continuity Is Independently Classified
normative_rule: Financial continuity SHALL be classified independently from execution completion settlement finality and current balance.

name: Reconstruction Does Not Restore Continuity
normative_rule: RECONSTRUCTED SHALL NOT imply PRESERVED continuity.

name: Restored Function Does Not Restore Continuity
normative_rule: FUNCTIONALLY_RESTORED SHALL NOT imply PRESERVED continuity.

name: Continuity Break Survives Later Equivalence
normative_rule: A demonstrated continuity break SHALL remain historically true even if later state becomes economically equivalent.

name: Indeterminate Continuity Is Not Preserved Continuity
normative_rule: Insufficient continuity evidence SHALL result in INDETERMINATE rather than PRESERVED classification.

name: Consensus Is Not Authority
normative_rule: Distributed consensus SHALL NOT by itself establish financial execution authority.

name: Ledger Validity Is Not Governance Admission
normative_rule: A ledger-valid transaction SHALL NOT be presumed governance-admissible.

name: Multi-Party Execution Requires Composable Authority
normative_rule: A multi-party financial transition SHALL NOT infer whole-chain authority from the authority of any single participant.

name: Remote State Is Execution Relevant
normative_rule: Execution-relevant remote counterparty or ledger state SHALL be incorporated where its change can alter admissibility.

name: Distributed Finality Does Not Erase Governance Failure
normative_rule: Consensus finality or replicated finality SHALL NOT erase evidence of prior authority admission or continuity failure.

name: Jurisdiction Is Execution Relevant State
normative_rule: Applicable jurisdiction SHALL be treated as execution-relevant state where it affects authority scope or admissibility.

name: Initial Jurisdiction Does Not Permanently Govern
normative_rule: Jurisdiction applicable at authorization SHALL NOT be presumed unchanged at later execution boundaries.

name: Cross-Boundary Authority Cannot Expand Implicitly
normative_rule: Crossing an institutional geographic regulatory or ledger boundary SHALL NOT implicitly expand authority.

name: Jurisdiction Conflict Must Be Explicit
normative_rule: Conflicting applicable jurisdictional constraints SHALL remain explicitly representable and SHALL NOT be silently collapsed.

name: Indeterminate Jurisdiction Cannot Authorize
normative_rule: Where required jurisdictional applicability cannot be established the affected consequential transition SHALL NOT be admitted.

name: Agent Capability Is Not Economic Authority
normative_rule: An autonomous agent's ability to construct sign transmit or execute a financial action SHALL NOT establish authority to do so.

name: Agent Must Resolve To Principal
normative_rule: Autonomous financial authority SHALL resolve to a valid principal or other explicitly recognized authority origin.

name: Delegation Attenuates
normative_rule: A delegated autonomous agent SHALL NOT possess authority broader than the authority validly delegated to it.

name: Agent Cannot Self-Authorize
normative_rule: An autonomous agent SHALL NOT create or validate the authority required for its own consequential financial execution unless explicitly authorized by a distinct upstream mechanism.

name: Agent Intent Drift Invalidates Admission
normative_rule: Material divergence between authorized economic intent and current agent action SHALL invalidate the inherited admission basis.
